title: Husbandry Tracker Plugin manifest (plugins/<name>/manifest.json)
description: The Plugin Standard's manifest. See docs/plugin-standard.md, CONTEXT.md: Plugin Contract, ADR 0061. web/plugin_catalog.py validates every plugins/<name>/manifest.json against this on every listing; a Plugin that fails is shown as Invalid and can't be activated.

name.description: Must equal the folder name under plugins/. Lowercase snake_case: it's also the Python package name, the Registry/Outbox file name, and the value stored in sensor.plugin/plug.plugin.

description.description: One line, shown on the Admin Plugins card.

how_it_works.description: A short paragraph for the Plugin's Settings page: how it reaches its devices (or what it does, for a Skill), and what it needs from the user.

device_types.description: Which Device Registration rows this Plugin backs. Required (non-empty) for kind=device, must be absent or empty for kind=skill.

entry_point.description: The Plugin file itself, relative to the Plugin folder — plugin.py for a device Plugin, skill/SKILL.md for a Skill. Must exist.

discovery.description: Present only if the Plugin ships discover.py (see docs/plugin-standard.md). Drives the Settings page's Scan button.

requires_settings.description: Setting keys that must be filled in before a scan can run.

settings.description: Plugin-specific settings, rendered generically on the Settings page and stored in plugin_setting. Never put a value here — only the field definitions.

setup_help.description: Optional ordered steps shown above the settings form (e.g. where to get credentials).
